title: Loopmaker's Trial source construction record
construction: Original self-contained SVG route plan with generated control points, a visible rider animation, and marked feature cards. Vertical point position changes height and horizontal spacing changes the sampled curvature radius. The server and exported verifier replay the same geometry, energy, speed, contact, and force equations; no source art, code, or task instance is bundled.
license_note: The cited survey entries and demonstrations supplied mechanic grounding only. All Loopmaker's Trial presentation, generated worlds, equations, and browser code are repository-authored.
source_limitations: The survey sources describe the interaction family and educational mechanics, not this exact room, art direction, thresholds, or generated route.
generated_media: No generated raster media; the route is original HTML/CSS/SVG geometry.
